programme.title: You Lucky Dog
programme.desc: Heartwarming drama with Natasha Henstridge. A fashion designer returns to her small hometown after her mother's death to help her brother save the family farm - with some help from a very special sheepdog.

programme.title: The Wild Girl
programme.desc: Ned Giles, an aspiring news photographer, joins the 1932 Great Apache Expedition on the search for a young boy, the son of a wealthy Mexican land owner who was kidnapped by wild Apaches. Ned finds himself on an unexpected and perilous journey through rugged terrain, when a captured wild Apache girl must be exchanged for the kidnapped boy.

programme.title: Meet The Santas
programme.desc: Steve Guttenberg stars in the comedy sequel to ʻSingle Santa Seeks Mrs Clausʼ. Shortly before he is due to take on his fatherʼs mantle, the son of Santa plans to wed on Christmas Eve. His fiancéeʼs prim-and-proper society mother disapproves of her choice of husband and insists on controlling every aspect of the wedding. Can Nick Claus win over his in-laws and ensure that the ceremony goes smoothly?

programme.title: The Crooked E: The Unshredded Truth About Enron
programme.desc: The rise and fall of the Enron company, as seen from the perspective of employee Brian Cruver, based on his book.

programme.title: Hard Ground
programme.desc: Billy Bucklin escapes while being transported to Yuma prison and plans to form an army of desperadoes to control the Mexican border. To finance his band, he robs a stagecoach, kidnaps a beautiful woman to be sold into prostitution, and steals an army payroll wagon. An aging lawman persuades the governor to parole his brother-in-law, now serving a 20-year prison term for murder, to assist him and his green deputy to destroy the marauders.

programme.title: Accidental Friendship
programme.desc: Life-affirming drama based on a true story. Following a chance encounter, a female police officer befriends a down-and-out who has lost everything but her dogs and is now living rough on the streets of Los Angeles. This unlikely friendship lasts a number of years, during which time the cop finds love and the homeless woman (Chandra Wilson, ʻGreyʼs Anatomyʼ) is encouraged to make a new start in life.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: Twelve years after the emperor's death, the Fremen armies have successfully subdued all known planets, killing off millions in numerous battles. The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

programme.title: Alice
programme.desc: Alice Tate is an upper-class New York housewife, who spends her days shopping, getting beauty treatments, and gossiping with her friends. She has been married to wealthy Doug for fifteen years, and they have two children, who are being raised by a nanny.

programme.desc: Mystery drama about a housewife who leads a double life as a government agent. Jane Doe has to find a missing British agent who has knowledge of the names and addresses of every UK operative in the Middle East. Was the man kidnapped, or did he arrange his own disappearance?

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Ross Tanner successfully deals with his multiple identity mystery and the terrorist threats as well as a top-level conspiracy including the White House chief of staff, which La Mangouste fails to protect against him. Wally Sheridan is elected instead of president Galbraith, who thanks him and general Carrington. Yet 'XIII' senses something isn't right.

programme.title: Strange Relations
programme.desc: Drama with Paul Reiser. When a Jewish New York psychologist is diagnosed with leukemia, his mother reveals that he was adopted from a Catholic teenager in the UK, leading to a journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Sea Beast / Troglodyte
programme.desc: Mythic creatures emerge from the sea to feast on the residents of a fishing village.

programme.title: Sorority Wars
programme.desc: Katie Parker (Lucy Hale) and Sara Snow (Phoebe Strole) have been friends since childhood. They enter college together, where Katie is a prized legacy candidate for the Delta sorority, which was co-founded decades ago by her mother, Lutie (Courtney Thorne-Smith) and Summer (Faith Ford), whose own daughter Gwen (Amanda Schull) now leads the Deltas on campus. Events occur during pledge week to cause a rift between Katie and the Deltas, which leaves Sara as a Delta pledge and Katie out in the cold. Katie joins the rival Kappa sorority, and the rivalry splits not just Katie and Sara, but extends all the way into the Delta alumnae association led by Lutie and Summer.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: Frank Darnell, director of the Central Security Agency (CSA), is at a loss when Miles Crandall, the genius who writes top-secret satellite communication software for his Pentagon-contracted company, disappears from a private jet flight, apparently by parachute, over the desert. CSA vet Cathy Davis, who retired to be a mother to husband Jack ad their kids, is secretly called in to solve the riddle, ironic given her cover as game designer for the US Puzzle Co. They soon realize the escape was staged, the question remains by whom and why. Meanwhile, Nick an unpopular bright nerd runs for class secretary, his haughty sister Susan fails to join the cheerleaders.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Now You See It, Now You Don't
programme.desc: Mystery with Lea Thompson. When the Declaration Of Independence is stolen while on display in a Los Angeles bank, puzzle solver Jane Doe is asked to help solve the case.

programme.title: Gentle Ben: Terror On The Mountain
programme.desc: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: Drama, with Dean Cain. Ranger Jack finds himself in prison after butting heads with Fog, who plans to drill for oil in his reserve, leaving Ben and Mark to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments
programme.desc: One of the most famous stories from The Bible, this mini-series sees the Hebrew infant, Moses, being raised in the Egyptian royal household. When his true identity is revealed, he sets out to reclaim his heritage. Later, the plagues descend on Egypt, and Pharaoh frees the Hebrews only to change his mind and pursue them to the Red Sea where the parting of the waves ensures their escape. After receiving the Ten Commandments, Moses faces an orgy of excess amongst his tribe.

programme.title: Just a Dream
programme.desc: Film crew arrives in a small town in Nevada desert. Ends up changing the life of a 12-year-old kid and a friend of his, a movie lover.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: Cain and Glitch rescue DG and Raw from the tower, and the group goes in search of the emerald. Meanwhile, Azkadellia plants a spy into their group so that she can use them to find the emerald for herself. Also, the truth behind what happened to DG and Azkadellia when they were younger is revealed, Glitch remembers his life before he lost his brain and the weapon he created, and Cain finds proof that his family may still be alive.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The Virgin Queen explores the full sweep of Elizabeth's life: from her days of fear as a potential victim of her sister's terror; through her great love affair with Robert Dudley; into her years of triumph over the Armada; and finally her old age and her last, enigmatic relationship with her young protégé, the Earl of Essex.

She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.desc: Modern take on Dickens's tale starring Tori Spelling and Dinah Manoff. An egomaniacal TV talk show host is determined to destroy the festive fun in the studio. (2003).

programme.desc: Mystery with Lea Thompson. When a ruthless arms dealer stages a prison escape, Jane Doe and NSA chief Frank Darnell quickly realise that a plot for deadly revenge lies behind it.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Wrong Face
programme.desc: Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: Historical drama with Patrick Stewart. In 1183, after the death of his eldest son, King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: Professor Thom Archer is convinced that the drilling by a corporate energy company, Halo, is having a devastating impact on the Greenland Glacier, one that will have dire consequences for mankind. In the year 2020, global warming has had a profound impact on the world, transforming much of Europe into desert, with only the United Kingdom and the United States seemingly unaffected by a devastating rain drought. When Professor Archer visits the Arctic to prove his theory, he realizes the entirety of the planet is under serious threat, and races home to save the ones he loves, and anyone else who will listen. Science-fiction mini series.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.desc: As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Harder They Fall
programme.desc: Mystery drama about a crime-fighting sleuth with a double life. Jane Doe investigates the death of a high-powered business mogul. She quickly discovers that the man's apparent drowning was staged to look like an accident.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

programme.title: Sea Beast / Troglodyte
programme.desc: Mythic creatures emerge from the sea to feast on the residents of a fishing village.

programme.title: Teens
programme.desc: The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Bundesliga. Bremen - RB Leipzig
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. programme.title: Secret Life of Predators: Compilation
programme.desc: Rivers and oceans are ruthless battlefields, constantly testing the bravery of even the biggest and deadliest carnivores.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more, discovering new habitats. Bertie Gregory learns about penguin problem solving, 'talking', and their continuing search for new worlds.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Survival of the Smartest. Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more. Riding powerful currents, the tiny adventurers arrived in strange new lands, reshaping traditions for deserts, tropics... and even among humans.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: This is the real story of the jungles made famous in Rudyard Kipling's 'Jungle Book'. It is a battlefield ruled by tooth and claw, where species fight for space, water, food, and mating rights. This is a world that knows nothing of compassion or kindness, dominated by two of the world's top predators, the Bengal Tiger and the Indian Wild Dog or Dhole. Kipling's Jungle Book was fiction. This is hard fact and a story that rewrites itself every year.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: The world's most ferocious land predators are pitted against each other in a series of challenges that push them to their limits.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Cecil: The Legacy of A King
programme.desc: In the heart of Zimbabwe's Hwange National Park, beneath towering mahogany and mopani trees, roamed one of Africa's most legendary lions-Cecil. Known for his immense size and regal presence, he was a dominant force in the wild long before his tragic fate at the hands of hunters made global headlines. While his death sparked international outrage, Cecil: The Legacy of a King shifts the focus to his extraordinary life. A warrior, a father, and a leader, Cecil's story is one of strength, survival, and the bonds that define a pride. This documentary honors the legacy of a lion who was more than just a symbol-he was a king.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)

The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: The world's most ferocious land predators are pitted against each other in a series of challenges that push them to their limits.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.title: An Elephant's World
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations. As we look into the minds of elephants, we see that their unique abilities to communicate, educate, and sympathize provide them with the necessary skills to survive. Yet, despite the strength and intelligence of these majestic creatures, humans are causing elephant populations to plummet around the world.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate journey through America's deserts. Everything in the desert lives and dies at the mercy of water. Dry, inhospitable wilderness, they are among the harshest, most extreme environments on the planet. Wind and water sculpt these thirst-lands into natural monuments… as unique as they are spectacular. But look closer and the desert reveals a SECRET WORLD of INTRIGUE… surprising stories of survival, epic perseverance… and things you've never seen before. All of America's deserts provide something… a hidden bounty for those who know where to find it… and how to use it. Title Final Yes.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard's hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: American Amazon
programme.desc: Secret Rivers. Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands.

Cheetahs and secretary birds must conquer extreme heat and elusive prey, risking their lives to feed their offspring. Mongolian wolves hunt for scarce food on the steppe.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Set in Botswana's vast and untamed wilderness, "Big Little Giants" follows Africa's youngest animals as they take their first steps into a challenging world shaped by drought, predators and ancient migration routes. From a newborn elephant learning to keep pace with its herd to jackal pups testing their instincts and cheetah cubs preparing for life at astonishing speed, each story unfolds through intimate moments of learning and loss. Guided by parents, siblings and instinct, these young animals must quickly adapt or fall behind. Through stunning landscapes and close-up encounters, discover how courage, family bonds and resilience shape survival during the most fragile stage of life in the wild.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It's late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol's also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden's pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Nature's Nurseries - The Next Wild Generation
programme.desc: Across the world, every species faces the same challenge: giving the next generation the best possible start. From gardens and farms to open fields and remote coastlines, animals raise their young in environments shaped by opportunity and risk. Sparrows and storks build homes alongside humans, making use of food and shelter, while butterflies depend on precise plant life to sustain their offspring. In open landscapes, skylarks nest far from disturbance, relying on camouflage and timing. In harsher climates, survival demands even more adaptation. Puffins time their chicks' arrival to brief seasons of abundance, while musk oxen shield newborns from freezing winds. Through intimate stories and striking settings, these journeys reveal how instinct, environment and resilience shape life's earliest and most vulnerable moments.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Safari action is unpredictable, unexpected and utterly raw. A lion captures birds midair, a baboon steals a leopard cub, a hyena plays tug-of-war with a crocodile, and a terrapin chases a lion away from his waterhole. Heroes and underdogs swap roles as nature's heartbreak can turn breathtaking in an instant. On safari, you'll witness nature's most astonishing characters.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: 50 baboons fight a hungry leopard, and an elephant family pulls together to save the smallest in the herd. As the dry season peaks, heading out on safari means checking any remaining waterholes. A leopard hunts bizarre fish in the mud while baboons raid nests on the riverbank. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of Jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil. A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. Clever capybaras and playful giant otters stick with their family members to avoid being jaguar dinner.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Safari action is unpredictable, unexpected and utterly raw. A lion captures birds midair, a baboon steals a leopard cub, a hyena plays tug-of-war with a crocodile, and a terrapin chases a lion away from his waterhole. Heroes and underdogs swap roles as nature's heartbreak can turn breathtaking in an instant. On safari, you'll witness nature's most astonishing characters.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Lion Brothers: Cubs To Kings
programme.desc: There's one thing that Leo has on his mind from birth - power. And he'll stop at nothing to get it. But life has other ideas and throws the book at this young upstart. With brother Max by his side, can Leo face his challenges and overcome his arrogance to become the King he's always dreamed he'd be?

programme.title: World's Deadliest Whale
programme.desc: Intelligent, cultured and deadly, the killer whale dominates every ocean on earth and as our planet changes, this top predator changes with it. They are elite, marine hunters with an extremely diverse diet including other apex predators like the great white shark. Killer whales pursue their prey like a pack of wolves and have multiple killing techniques.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Jellyfish
programme.desc: Jellyfish can grow longer than a blue whale and are the deadliest creature on the planet. They have no bones, teeth or brain and can thrive where others perish. Their power lies in tentacles packed with venom and out of 2,000 species of jellyfish, around 70 can be dangerous to us.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Littlefoot: Marlene is dying to go see a concert in the park. But, every time she leaves the zoo she becomes a feral monster! Kowalski comes to the rescue with his invention the Persona-Disentangleizer, which separates her savage nature from her regular self. The savage Marlene escapes and rampages through the city. Can the Penguins stop her before she destroys the city? Smotherly Love: Ma, an empty-nested mother possum, takes up residence in the Penguins Lair after they destroy her home during a battle with Hans the Puffin. She smothers the penguins with love and nurturing, and gets her new boys to behave by playing possum whenever necessary. The battle-hardened unit devolves into a bunch of softies, opening the door for Hans to take advantage. It looks like he has the upper wing, unless someone can make a play to stop him!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: A Kipper for Skipper: It's off to the races when Skipper agrees to give a day off from hard training to the first penguin who can bring him a kipper. Private, Rico, and Kowalski battle their way to a fish packing plant where they discover Officer X has become Fishmonger X. The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? High Moltage: The penguins are determined to make opening day of their favorite action star's blockbuster movie! Private, however, has an itchy problem - he's turned hideous because he's molting! The penguins need his hypercute powers to knock Alice out and disengage her new zoo security system. The despondent bird does all he can to reconstruct his cuteness, but sadly his hypercute powers distort to cause a hyperalarming, hypervomitous mess!

Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

Gone: SpongeBob wakes up one morning to find that everyone in Bikini Bottom is gone - even Gary!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: Pedro galletto coraggioso: Missione Africa
programme.desc: Avventuroso sequel animato con il simpatico pennuto. Pedro e Di sono i genitori di due piccole uova dorate, che vengono rapite e portate in Africa dalla cattivissima Duchessa.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Un bel giorno
programme.desc: Nuova commedia di successo per Fabio De Luigi e Virginia Raffaele. Tommaso, vedovo con quattro figlie, conosce Lara. L'incontro può cambiare tutto, ma entrambi nascondono qualcosa.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Sonic - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden, fra live action e animazione, nell’avventura basata sulla serie di videogiochi della Sega. Sonic, un porcospino più veloce del suono, approda sulla Terra per sfuggire ai cacciatori che lo braccano e si ritrova ad affrontare un diabolico scienziato.

programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Il prodigioso Maurice
programme.desc: Animazione Sky Original dal romanzo di Terry Pratchett. L'astuto gatto Maurice coinvolge nel suo piano truffaldino una banda di topi parlanti e il giovane pifferaio Keith.

programme.title: Clean Up Crew - Specialisti in lavori sporchi
programme.desc: Quando la squadra di pulizia di una scena del crimine scopre una valigetta piena di soldi, deve superare in astuzia un boss criminale e degli agenti corrotti dell'FBI che la rivogliono indietro.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: Un disertore della CIA accusa l'ufficiale Evelyn Salt di essere una spia russa. Convinta di essere vittima di un complotto, la donna si dà alla fuga.

programme.title: L'implacabile
programme.desc: Disperato e alla ricerca di denaro per salvare la figlia malata, Ben Richards si unisce al programma tv "The Running Man", una competizione in cui i concorrenti devono sopravvivere per 30 giorni mentre vengono braccati da assassini professionisti.

programme.title: Transformers 4 - L'era dell'estinzione
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg nel quarto capitolo della saga dedicata ai personaggi della Hasbro. Alcuni anni dopo la distruzione di Chicago, un inventore ritrova Optimus Prime, il leader degli Autobot.

programme.title: Atomica bionda
